headline: Round two of the Grand Slam of Darts finishes at 2:00 PM New York time, and Arsenal Women host Lyon in the Women's Champions League at 3:00 PM.
today: 2:00 PM: Grand Slam of Darts, round two (Clemens v Aspinall, van Veen v Schindler, Humphries v Sykes, Wade v van Gerwen), ESPN+/Hulu Live.
3:00 PM: Arsenal Women v Lyon, Women's Champions League, ESPN+/Paramount+.
8:00 PM: Knicks at Timberwolves, NBA, NBA TV.

recaps.text: Luke Littler was knocked out of the Grand Slam of Darts in round two, losing 10-8 to Jermaine Wattimena, who now meets Kevin Doets in the quarter-finals.
Wakamotoharu leads the Kyushu sumo basho alone at 10-1 after day 11, one win clear of Onosato, Atamifuji and Kinbozan.

lookAhead: Saturday has the first T20I from the MCG at 3:15 AM, England v New Zealand at 9:10 AM and Arsenal at Newcastle at 12:30 PM; Sunday has the Grand Slam final at 2:30 PM and the Jets at the Chargers at 4:05 PM.
